## Checklist

- [ ] The description is a short summary of the changes and nothing else.
- [ ] It contains no agent session links, attribution footers, or “generated by” trailers.
- [ ] It contains no secrets, tokens, `.env` contents, internal URLs, signing material, or private artifacts.
- [ ] It contains no pasted logs, stack traces, or environment dumps; failing jobs are referenced instead.
- [ ] Local `pnpm verify` passes; this PR remains draft until it does.
